items.reason: GroupPermissionsV2.java:142–153 deliberately uses all-groups permissions only when no group-specific resource exists, matching the V2 fallback logic in UserPermissionsV2.java:105–118. UserResourceTypeEvaluationTest.java:101–113 explicitly verifies that a specific permission overrides an all-resources grant. Adding the proposed canView() shortcut would bypass that precedence; the V1 behavior does not establish a V2 defect.

GroupResource.java:322 and :355 guard both endpoints with the V1 ADMIN_FINE_GRAINED_AUTHZ feature before calling permission-management methods. Profile.java:283–306 prevents simultaneous feature versions, and ProfileHelper.java:30–32 returns HTTP 501 when the required feature is disabled. Consequently, V2 requests cannot reach the claimed UnsupportedOperationException.
